mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tv_record WHERE kind=#{kind} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1000
mapper.update: UPDATE tv_record SET document=#{document},revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision}
UPDATE tv_record SET revision=revision WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT cls.state_json AS classification_state, cls.revision AS classification_revision, song.*, source.name AS source_name, meta.track_json AS metadata_track, meta.fields_json AS metadata_fields, meta.applied_at AS metadata_applied_at, meta.origins_json AS metadata_origins, meta.fingerprint AS metadata_fingerprint FROM media_song song JOIN media_source source ON source.id=song.source_id LEFT JOIN song_metadata meta ON meta.song_id=song.id LEFT JOIN classification_song cls ON cls.song_id=song.id ORDER BY song.id
